lyrics: There's a father on his knees late at night Praying strength into tired hands A mother giving pieces of her heart So her child has a chance to stand Love don't always come with applause Sometimes it bleeds, sometimes it breaks It's quiet, holy, unseen But it's written in the choices they make Every "yes" costs something Every cross has weight But love keeps walking forward Even when the road won't wait That's the shape of sacrifice Love laid down so life can rise From a manger to a wooden tree From a home to Calvary Hands that give, hearts that stay Fathers, mothers, Christ who paid Different stories, same price All love wears the shape of sacrifice There's a Savior with a crown of thorns Breathing mercy through the pain He could've called down angels But love chose nails instead of chains He saw our names before the scars Knew the cost and stayed anyway The greatest gift the world would know Was a life He freely gave Every tear held purpose Every wound brought grace He turned suffering into freedom And death into a doorway That's the shape of sacrifice Love laid down so life can rise From a manger to a wooden tree From a home to Calvary Hands that give, hearts that stay Fathers, mothers, Christ who paid Different stories, same price All love wears the shape of sacrifice It's staying when it's easier to leave It's believing when you cannot see It's breaking so another heart survives It's love that gives up its own life That's the power of sacrifice Hope reborn in willing hearts Every prayer, every sleepless night Every tear God never forgot What was lost is multiplied Grace written in every life Through the cross and family ties We are saved by sacrifice From heaven's throne to a child's bed Love was spoken, love was led Forevermore the truth remains Sacrifice is love's true name

They stretched Him wide on cruel wood, The hammer fell, the earth it shook; They nailed His hands, they nailed His feet, As heaven held its breath to the beat. O Lamb of God-lifted high, Hear this sinner's broken cry; Remember me-remember me- O Christ who died on Cal-va-ry. I cursed the Man upon that tree, With dying lungs and blasphemy; Condemned by law, by guilt, by sin, No hope in sight, no light within. O Lamb of God-lifted high, Hear this sinner's broken cry; Remember me-remember me- O Christ who died on Cal-va-ry. They pierced His side, the sky grew dim, The light of day withdrew from Him; I turned my head with failing breath, One final plea before my death. O Lamb of God-lifted high, Hear this sinner's broken cry; Remember me-remember me- O Christ who died on Cal-va-ry. He turned His face though death drew near, And spoke through pain both calm and clear: "This day with Me you shall abide," Then bowed His head-and so He died. O Lamb of God-lifted high, Hear this sinner's broken cry; Remember me-remember me- O Christ who died on Cal-va-ry. Remember me... O Christ who died on Cal-va-ry.

title: Don't Remember Me
lyrics: If my name ever crosses your mind one day, If you hear my voice when you kneel and pray, Don't lift me up, don't sing my praise, I'm just a sinner saved by mercy and grace. I've seen this world turn bitter and mean, Hearts grow hard where love should be, And it cuts me deep, the pain I see, Lord knows this life can be heavy on me. Mm-hmm... mercy, Lord Yes, grace... If my life ever says a word at all- Let it tell 'em 'bout the Lord If my feet ever walks a narrow road- Point 'em to the cross Don't remember me- Remember the cross The blood that was shed- For the sinner lost If my voice moves your heart to believe- Fall on your knees At the foot of that old rugged tree I'm just a sign on a dusty road- Pointin' home To a Savior who carried the load- Jesus bore it all If you see anything good in me- Give Him the glory Let it lead you straight to Jesus, not me I love every soul, the broken, the weak, The ones who still think they're too far gone to reach, I've sat with the hurt, I've heard their cries, Seen hope come alive through tear-filled eyes. This world's got a way of tearing you down, Chewing up faith, grinding saints in the ground, But there's a hope that never runs dry- It stood in a grave... and walked out alive. He got up! Yes He did! I ain't the truth, I ain't the way- Jesus Is! I'm just a voice trying to say- He saves! Don't remember me- Remember the cross The nails, the thorns- The sacri-fice If my song ever reaches your soul- Let Him take control Fall down at Calvary I'm just a witness, I can't save- Give it! to a risen King and an empty grave- The grave couldn't hold Him! If you hear anything when I speak- Hear Jesus! Let it sound like Jesus calling you, not me I didn't save you He Does! I didn't bleed He Did! I didn't rise on the third day Jesus did! I didn't break those chains you wear He broke 'em! I just know the One who meets you there Thank You, Lord! So don't remember me- Remember His name! The One who took our guilt and shame- Jesus! If my life ever leaves a trace- Let it point to grace! And mercy flowing from that place When my days are done and my voice is still- He's still God! Let the echo stand on that lonely hill- Calvary! Remember Jesus... Don't remember me Remember the cross... Remember His name... Jesus... Jesus...
